test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Prudent
solution:
The correct answer is “**Stupid**”.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Prudent**" means showing care and thought for the future; it comes from the notion of being wise or judicious in the management of affairs. (भविष्य के लिए देखभाल और विचार दिखाना) 

 
 
• **Example**- Making a budget is a prudent decision to manage one's finances.
 
 
 
• "**Stupid**" means lacking intelligence or common sense. (बुद्धिमत्ता या सामान्य ज्ञान की कमी होना)
 
 
• **Example**- Ignoring the warning signs was a stupid mistake that could have easily been avoided.
 
 
 
• Hence, the option that is Opposite in meaning to the given word is 'Stupid’.

Therefore, the correct answer is ‘**Option 3’.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let’s have a look at the meaning of the remaining options.
 
• **Wise**: having or showing experience, knowledge, and good judgment. (अनुभव, ज्ञान, और अच्छे निर्णय का प्रदर्शन करना)
 
• **Atrocious**: horrifyingly wicked or of a very poor quality. (डरावना बुरा या बहुत ही खराब गुणवत्ता का)
 
• **Crafty**: clever at achieving one's aims by indirect or deceitful methods. (अप्रत्यक्ष या धोखेबाज़ तरीकों से अपने उद्देश्यों को प्राप्त करने में चालाक)
